summary: Verified WhiteLabel branding-fix in sandbox. Backend endpoints (/api/branding, /api/admin/sales/login, /api/admin/sales/overview) return expected results. Frontend /sales renders the Sales & Profit login gate (no Nomadly bot landing), subheading shows 'Nomadly · Admin Analytics' (expected in sandbox), wrong password shows 'Incorrect password' inline error, correct password (sandbox-sales-test) logs in and renders full dashboard with Logout control. All acceptance criteria met.

issues: Non-blocking React hydration warnings: visual-editor <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers are being injected inside <tbody>/<tr>/<select> resulting in invalid HTML nesting (span child of tbody, span child of tr, span child of select). Non-blocking but produces console errors on load.
Recharts warnings: 'width(-1) and height(-1) of chart should be greater than 0' — chart containers rendered before parent had layout width. Non-blocking.

action_items: Optional: investigate visual-editor injected <span data-ve-dynamic> wrappers producing hydration warnings inside table/select in SalesDashboard.js (non-blocking).
Optional: give chart containers explicit min-height to eliminate Recharts width/height warnings.
critical_code_review_comments: Branding runtime override is working end-to-end: /api/branding returns valid JSON with 'name' field; index.js applyRuntimeBranding().finally(render) properly gates render.
/sales route correctly restored in App.js and renders SalesDashboard bypassing the landing page.
Sales login/overview auth flow correct: token issued on match, 401 on mismatch / missing token.
context_for_next_testing_agent: Fix verified in sandbox at https://vault-init-6.preview.emergentagent.com/sales . Backend brand endpoint returns Nomadly (expected). On WhiteLabel prod (app-wl) the brand becomes 'Smadav'. All 6 acceptance criteria from the review request passed.
